name: airbrush-chromatic-render
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:
· MEDIUM: a hyperreal airbrushed digital painting / render — smooth painterly modelling of skin and fabric, uncanny glossy CGI realism, tight cropped low three-quarter angle.
· GROUND: a flat emerald / bottle-green backdrop carved with soft concentric wavy moiré line ripples.
· LIGHT: dramatic saturated club lighting, cool sheen on the skin, glossy speculars on equipment surfaces.
· SIGNATURE TREATMENT: strong RGB chromatic-aberration fringing (red / cyan splits) along every edge, giving a printed-then-mis-registered feel.
· PALETTE: emerald green and cobalt / royal blue as the complementary pair, over warm airbrushed skin, with small hot red and lime accents.
· MOOD: gritty, sweaty late-night nightclub, intense and uncanny.
· GRAIN: dense gritty photographic grain laid over the smooth render, matte and noisy.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
